title: 7 Best Herbal Creams For Bad Breath
intro: Herbal creams for bad breath are topical treatments that contain natural ingredients and essential oils extracted from herbs, plants, and flowers to combat halitosis. These creams have several benefits, including their ability to kill bacteria that cause bad breath, reduce inflammation, and provide a fresh and pleasant mouth sensation. Examples of herbal creams for bad breath include peppermint creams that cool the mouth and reduce bacteria, eucalyptus creams that decongest and freshen the breath, neem creams that have antibacterial properties to kill bacteria, clove creams that have anti-inflammatory properties to soothe the gums, and tea tree creams that have antiseptic properties to prevent infections. By using these herbal creams, individuals can enjoy a fresher breath and a healthier mouth without the need for harsh chemicals or antibiotics.

preparations.preparation_desc: Mentha x piperita creams, derived from the peppermint plant, have long been used to treat bad breath due to their antiseptic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties. These properties help to reduce the growth of oral bacteria, which can cause bad breath, and also soothe the oral mucosa to alleviate inflammation and discomfort. The bioactive constituents of Mentha x piperita, including menthol and menthone, exhibit antimicrobial properties that help to inhibit the growth of bacteria responsible for bad breath. By using Mentha x piperita creams, individuals can benefit from a natural and effective treatment for bad breath, promoting oral health and hygiene.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Avicenna journal of phytomedicine", Mentha x piperita creams for bad breath may be effective as the essential oils of Mentha piperita were able to remove oral biofilms in 45 seconds and were shown to have significant effects on inhibition of oral bacteria biofilm formation.
